name: Chicken Cheese
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: a plump chicken weighing about 4 or 5 pounds when dressed
ingredients.originalText: a plump chicken weighing about 4 or 5 pounds when dressed
ingredients.quantityText: a plump chicken weighing about 4 or 5 pounds when dressed

ingredients.name: lump of butter, cut fine, size of an egg

instructions.text: Put chicken on and boil till tender and well done
Remove all the bones and grisly parts and chop fine, with a little salt and pepper
Boil down the water it was cooked in to a pint, and it jellies, and stir it in with the chicken
Put bread through the meat grinder with a lump of butter, cut fine, size of an egg, a little sage, salt and pepper
Stir in 2 beaten eggs to hold it together
Put half of the chicken chopped in a deep earthen or granite dish, spread level
Put on the dressing, spread level, then the rest of the minced chicken
Set in the oven till hot, then set in a cool place over night

source.originalInstructions:
1. Put chicken on and boil till tender and well done
2. Remove all the bones and grisly parts and chop fine, with a little salt and pepper
3. Boil down the water it was cooked in to a pint, and it jellies, and stir it in with the chicken
4. Put bread through the meat grinder with a lump of butter, cut fine, size of an egg, a little sage, salt and pepper
5. Stir in 2 beaten eggs to hold it together
6. Put half of the chicken chopped in a deep earthen or granite dish, spread level
7. Put on the dressing, spread level, then the rest of the minced chicken
8. Set in the oven till hot, then set in a cool place over night
9. When cold slice and serve
